description: issue #874, the check half of a check/execute pair: `(clear_screen 10)` raises ol-too-many-inputs at the SEMANTIC stage here, with the same code, callable, expected, and actual as its runtime twin turtle-rendering/screen/clear-screen-too-many-inputs raises at the RUNTIME stage for byte-identical source. Reading the two fixtures side by side is the agreement #874 asked for, pinned in both directions: before the fix this program checked clean and only failed when run, so a learner's editor said nothing and the turtle then refused to move.
